title: M and V
summary: Two new keys: M and V. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: M and V. They belong to your right index finger and your left index finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If M and V already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.

screens.text: This key belongs to your right index finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only M and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
screens.content:
snt m sn
m m mm
mmmm

screens.text: This key belongs to your left index finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only V and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
screens.content:
vvvv mmmm
mvmvmv vmvmvm
vm mv

screens.text: Short groups, one after another. Keep going to the end even if you miss one.
The new keys mixed with the old ones, which is how they will turn up inside words.
screens.content:
vm mv vmvm
tttt vvv mmmm nnn
mvmvmv vmvmvm

screens.text: Real words with the new keys. Type each word in one go, not letter by letter.
screens.content:
something game modern means
river having comes mother
name serve minute movement

screens.text: A burst of short words with the new keys in them.
Now the weight is on M, the one you have pressed least.
screens.content:
natural us strong matter
meet college means mountain
provide sour protect an

screens.text: Back to patterns for a moment, to check that the fingers still find their way home.
screens.content:
mvmv vmvm
vm vm
snt mv sn

screens.text: Everything you have, mixed together. Notice how many words already come without thinking.
